Name: Eubulus
Summary: Eubulus was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Pudens, Linus, and Claudia.
KeyStory: Eubulus was one of the believers with Paul in Rome who sends greetings in 2 Timothy, alongside Pudens, Linus, and Claudia.
LifeLesson: Greetings from Rome's believers show a church standing with its prisoner.
